notes: PARTIAL (2026-11-16, the 1985 code reads, rulings of batch 11): Two programs that describe one external relative file may name RELATIVE KEY items of the same name at DIFFERENT character positions of the external record, and the compiler accepts it: it identifies the item by its name path alone. See below: decided. Owner: kb/Work PB5857 (open). Ruled in kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-16-rulings-code-reads-batch-11.md; the 1985 rows chained into this one: 1985-GR-VIII.2.4.4-8. It is the rule's item h (the RELATIVE KEY clause) that the mechanism breaks. The prose that follows is the stored account, kept as the account of the part that holds. || CONFORMS, kb/Work PB5733 (fixed): the refusal half holds (entries that disagree are refused COBOL6847), and now the agreeing half holds too: FileRegistry.RegisterIndexed records that a later describer of an existing ::EXT:: connector has its alternate keys already on the shared connector, and AddAlternateKey for that name returns, so the connector keeps one set of alternate keys and the second program's OPEN no longer gets status 39. Witness pb5733_external_alternate_keys_agree (two programs, two alternate keys, one WITH DUPLICATES; READ by the second key). Rule: 'If the file connector referenced by file-name-1 is an external file connector ..., all file control entries in the run unit that reference this file connector shall have:' a)-m) (cite.py --check §2023:12.4.5.3 GR1 OK). FileEntryIdentity.Segments is the one list of the GR1 items an entry specifies; two readers compare it: ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check for the entries of one compilation group at every edition (COBOL6847; the 1985 and 2002 texts state the same rule, §1985:VII.2.3.4 GR1, §2002:12.3.4.3 GR1, and add PADDING CHARACTER), and the run time's EC-EXTERNAL-FILE-MISMATCH between separately compiled elements (FileEntryIdentity.Of into SelectFingerprint, OoEmitter.EmitExternalDescribes, ExternalTable). h) RELATIVE KEY is an external data item and the same one at every edition (COBOL1624, COBOL1575); i) FILE STATUS at 2023 (COBOL1624, COBOL1573). retired-witness: conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/w68r_pb1079_external_entry_identity (moved to wiseowl/cases with each called program its own compilation unit (kb/Work PB5069); the row names the new path)
